notes.title: Patch Notes, Version 2.72 – 28 August, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

 You can polymorph to out-of-difficulty forms by chance if you have high luck.
 Monsters can polymoprh to out-of-difficulty forms by chance if you have low luck.
 Invisible pets can now steal from shops.
 Various bug fixes.


There's no version 2.71 on Windows.

notes.title: Patch Notes, Version 2.65 – 8 August, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

 Monsters and items are now slightly highlighted when moving the cursor above them.
 Fixes to the thread-safety of the sound system.
 Music volume is now properly restored after interrupting a dialogue.
 Various other bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes, Version 2.64 – 4 August, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

 Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes, Version 2.63 – 31 July, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

 Added dedicated settings for toggling the visibility of each of the four optional stone UI buttons.
 Travelling is not interrupted anymore by peaceful monsters casting indirectional spells.
 Various other bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes, Version 2.62 – 30 July, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

 Improved the positioning and sizing of extended status bar / status screen.
 Improved text memory handling performance, especially for CustomLabel and TextCanvas.
 Fixed a bug that could cause spell sorting to cause error messages after forgetting a spell.
 Various other bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes, Version 2.50 – 1 July, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

 GPU Acceleration support. It can now be enabled in the settings. In the case of multiple GPUs, the used GPU must be selected in Windows Settings → System → Display → Graphics. It defaults to the integrated GPU.
 Bug fixes.
